The '''Shafr system''' was located in the [[Toblain sector/Legends|Toblain sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[Trailing Sectors/Legends|Trailing Sectors]] portion of<ref name="Trailing" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It shared its name with the [[Shafr Center]] institution<ref name="Gamer9">{{GamerCite|9|Race for the Tessent}}</ref> as well as the work ''[[The Shafr Anthology of Galactic Language, Second Edition]]'' that was published in [[38 ABY]] by [[Shafr Center Press/Legends|The Shafr Center Press]].<ref name="Written">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/source/writtenword/index.html?page=1|text=The Written Word|int=The Written Word}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Shafr [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square O-17.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
